question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this shared durable Gitcrawl receipt vocabulary and prepared first-writer replay contract as part of the current stacked landing sequence?
rationale: The patch appears internally correct, but it establishes durable schema and replay semantics that the later cloud/parity consumer will depend on; code review cannot choose that long-lived contract or landing order without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the stacked contract
options.body: Land the dependency stack in order, preserving the digest-only boundary and requiring live consumer proof before workflow activation.

options.title: Hold for consumer review
options.body: Keep this draft open until the consumer branch proves that the proposed receipt slots and replay semantics cover the complete operational path without further schema churn.

options.title: Decline ledger expansion
options.body: Keep Gitcrawl evidence ephemeral and remove the durable receipt API if maintainers do not want this evidence family in the shared action ledger.

recommendation.title: Approve the stacked contract
recommendation.body: Land the dependency stack in order, preserving the digest-only boundary and requiring live consumer proof before workflow activation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the connected Gitcrawl evidence stack and has the clearest history for explaining the intended durable contract and landing sequence.
